verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, so user-configurable background automations are a software and agent capability outside this product's category. Ryzen Master's 'Auto Overclock' and tuning profiles are performance-tuning features, not autonomous task automations, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
